name: 09-zod-errors-shared-node-helper
title: Reuse the own-property node() helper in formatError and treeifyError
body: flattenError already goes through the shared `node()` helper for creating own-property tree nodes, while formatError and treeifyError each inlined the same hasOwnProperty/defineProperty logic. This switches both to `node()` and drops the duplicated comments.

bugs.why: The child node is looked up on the root `fieldErrors` instead of `curr`, so nested paths like ['a','b'] are flattened onto the top level and the nested structure is lost.
